name: net_session_config_dialog_do_data_exchange
description: NetSessionConfigDialog::DoDataExchange binds the session configuration controls and validates their numeric/text ranges. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41c880 validates DDX_Control calls for max/value/time spin controls and map combo using ids 1072, 1121, 1120, and 1116; DDX_Text/DDV_MaxChars for session name id 1115 with max 80; unsigned DDX_Text/DDV_MinMaxUInt for value and time ids 1117/1118 with range 0..10000; unsigned DDX_Text/DDV_MinMaxUInt for max players id 1119 with range 2..8; and DDX_Check id 1122 for the unused checkbox field.
The native smoke patches the MFC DDX/DDV provider calls and verifies the call order, data-exchange context, control ids, field addresses, sampled values, and validation ranges.
